source_lead: sources/leads/documented_edges_round5.md, 'Idea 1. Dated-futures cash-and-carry held to delivery on Binance (H-DATEDBASIS)' (the task brief calls it idea 2). Lead evidence: Christin et al. 2022 (CMU), BIS WP 1087. Both document modality, not validated.
frozen_before_pnl: Written after listing the data.binance.vision archive (symbol names only) and probing URL availability; no price, basis or P&L value had been loaded or computed.

universe.usdm: USDS-M quarterly delivery contracts BTCUSDT_YYMMDD, ETHUSDT_YYMMDD (every one in the archive). BUSD monthly contracts (BTCBUSD_210129/210226) are excluded: not quarterly.
universe.coinm: Every COIN-M quarterly <COIN>USD_YYMMDD in the archive (ADA, BCH, BNB, BTC, DOT, EOS, ETC, ETH, FIL, LINK, LTC, SOL, TRX, XRP) whose <COIN>USDT spot 1h klines exist on Binance spot over the trade window.
universe.trade_unit: each (coin, contract, weekly entry). Effective n by (coin, contract) cluster and by delivery cycle also reported.

splits.validation: delivery 2025-07-01..2026-03-31 (250926, 251226, 260327); run ONCE, only for configs passing the full bar on train

decision: Every Monday 00:00 UTC. Prices: 1h close of the bar ending at 00:00 (open 23:00 Sunday) of the dated future and of spot. Requires both bars present and futures bar volume > 0 (stale-quote guard); else no decision (counted as skipped).
window: days to delivery D = (delivery 08:00 UTC - decision time)/1 day, 21 <= D <= 120.
entry: b - c_rt*365/D >= h_t + margin. h_t = latest FRED DTB3 3-month T-bill value dated strictly before the decision date (percent/100). c_rt = round-trip cost: spot 0.10%x2 + futures taker 0.05% entry + settlement 0.05% + 4 x slip (slip = 2 bp BTC/ETH, 5 bp others).
fill: Next 1h close (bar 00:00-01:00 Monday) on both legs; spot bought at close*(1+slip), future sold at close*(1-slip); futures fill bar must have volume > 0, else no trade. One position per (coin, contract, entry week); entries in successive weeks for the same contract are separate trades (overlap acknowledged).
hold_and_settlement: To delivery. Settlement price P = mean of the Binance index 1m closes over 07:00-08:00 UTC on the delivery date (Binance Square post 42880 says 'average price of the last hour'; other sources say 30 min, reported as sensitivity). Spot sold at the mean of spot 1m closes over the same window *(1-slip) (TWAP proxy). Settlement fee 0.05% (assumption; one secondary source says 0.015%).

pnl.usdm: q coins long spot, q short future. Capital K = spot cost + 1x isolated margin (= futures notional at entry). P&L = q(S_exit - S_in) + q(F_in - P) - fees. Margin event: if a future 1h high >= 1.6 x F_in, close both legs at that bar's close, future +50 bp, spot -slip, taker fees.
pnl.coinm: Short face V USD of inverse contracts at F_in; buy Q = V/F_in coins spot (exact USD hedge, no convexity residual) and post them as COIN-M collateral. Capital K = Q*S_in*(1+spot fee). Coin balance at delivery = V/P - fees in coin; sold on spot. No margin event (coin-collateralised 1x short keeps a constant margin ratio). Contract-size rounding ignored.
pnl.primary_metric: r_ex = r_raw - h_t * days_held/365 (excess over T-bills on ALL capital tied up: spot and margin). The bar is applied to r_ex.
pnl.annualised: capital-time-weighted: sum(P&L)/sum(K*years held), for r_raw and r_ex; plus per-trade r*365/days.

V4_base_early_exit.early_exit: on each later Monday with D_rem >= 7: if (F/S - 1)*365/D_rem < h_t, close both legs at the next 1h close (spot fee + slip, futures taker 0.05% + slip; no settlement fee)

costs.spot: 0.10% per side, Binance regular user, https://www.binance.com/en/fee/schedule (as cited in round-5 doc, fetched 2026-10-05)
costs.futures: taker 0.05% per side, USDS-M and COIN-M regular user, https://www.binance.com/en/support/articles/360033544231
costs.slippage: 2 bp per leg BTC/ETH, 5 bp others
costs.capital: T-bill (DTB3, https://fred.stlouisfed.org/graph/fredgraph.csv?id=DTB3) on all capital for the holding time

bar: n>=50, net r_ex sum > 0, PF(r_ex) > 1.2, sum r_ex > 0 without the 3 best trades
selection: All variants that pass the bar on train go to validation once. No other tuning.
